## Question

Write one sentence explaining what this report summarizes.

## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("analysis.R")
```

## Summary

```{r clinic-summary, echo=FALSE}
data.frame(
  statistic = c("Number of records", "Mean age", "Median marker"),
  value = c(n_records, mean_age, median_marker)
)
```
